description:
Deterministic syntax-closure burn-down contract for systemverilog.ebnf (no-regression baseline). Entry rule is sv_multi_entry_root, a synthetic union of the three legitimate top-level entries (systemverilog_file, library_text, systemverilog_parseable_file) used so the gate's single-entry static analyzer can see all reach-sets at once. Long-term tooling fix: extend ast_pipeline --entry-rule to accept a list and remove sv_multi_entry_root.

v2 (2026-05-29, SV-EXH-PROOF.5.1, PGEN-SV-EXH-PROOF-0102): re-baselined max_unreachable_rules 1 to 50 and max_unreachable_branches 25 to 109 to honestly reflect the accumulated intentional-orphan surface. Each of the 50 unreachable rules is individually justified:

  - 1 known LRM mutual-recursion case: module_path_conditional_expression (documented in grammar lines 79-89; intentionally LRM-faithful; PGEN runtime RecursionGuard handles it correctly; static analyzer cannot trace mutual reference).

  - 49 LRM-decomposed number-infrastructure orphans (documented in grammar lines 416-423, PGEN-SV-EXH-PROOF-0021/.3.2 Strategy 1 precedent + RGX-0081 orphan-rule precedent). The 4 entry-point number-kind rules (binary_number, octal_number, decimal_number, hex_number) are alias passthroughs to integral_number (a clean sized/based regex) but no production references them. The remaining 45 are their decomposed helpers (binary_base/digit/value/value_tail, octal_*, hex_*, decimal_base/digit, size, exp, fixed_point_number, non_zero_decimal_digit x 2 profiles, non_zero_unsigned_number x 2, sign, x_digit, z_digit, plus 16 kw_* single-character keyword helpers like kw_A_/kw_C_/.../kw_n_3_/.../kw_o_/kw_sv_rule_).

The 109 unreachable_branches count = static sub-quantifier accounting of those same 50 unreachable rules' branches.

Drift policy: any future grammar edit that changes either ceiling MUST be leaf-owned + justified per [[feedback_grammar_edit_proof_gate_lockstep]] - re-baseline is honest closure-debt management, NOT silent masking. Adding a NEW unreachable rule requires either (a) wiring it into the reach-set, (b) deleting the orphan, or (c) opening a leaf that explains why the new orphan is intentional + bumping the ceiling.

v3 (2026-06-06, GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.A1b.2, PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0032): re-baselined the no-regression FLOORS downward after two LEGITIMATE profile-variant collapses landed since v2 (verified via git diff that exactly these two defined-rule names disappeared between the v2 baseline commit f5b25b3d and HEAD): (1) binary_module_path_operator_sv_2023 was collapsed into its canonical form by PGEN-ANNOTATION-COMPOSITION-0002 (it was REACHABLE -> min_reachable_rules 1407 to 1406); (2) non_zero_decimal_digit_sv_2017 was collapsed into the base non_zero_decimal_digit by PGEN-ANNOTATION-COMPOSITION-0005 (it was a BLESSED unreachable number orphan -> removed from the blessed list, max_unreachable_rules 50 to 49, unreachable_rules 50 to 49). Net: min_total_rules 1455 to 1453. Both collapses are documented, leaf-owned, corpus-14/14-verified grammar-quality cleanups (NOT regressions) -- this is honest closure-debt management per the drift policy, lowering stale floors to match the legitimately-reduced grammar, never masking a real reachability loss (the 49-orphan ceiling is still individually justified and reachability is otherwise unchanged).

v4 (2026-06-15, GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.1, PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0076): the SV cert-coverage UNKNOWN->0 drive applied the drift-policy 'delete the orphan' path (option b) to the ENTIRE blessed LRM-decomposed-number-infrastructure orphan surface. All 48 dead useless symbols (the 27 lrm_decomposed_number_orphans + the 21 lrm_decomposed_number_kw_helpers) were removed at source from systemverilog.ebnf -- they were severed from the reach-set when PGEN-SV-EXH-PROOF-0021/.3.2 Strategy 1 consolidated integral_number/real_number/unsigned_number into clean single regexes, and an independent reference-graph dead-closure from the three real entries reproduced exactly this 48-rule set. Re-baselined: max_unreachable_rules 49 -> 1 (only the module_path_conditional_expression LRM mutual-recursion case remains), max_unreachable_branches 109 -> 11 (that one rule's branch accounting), min_total_rules 1453 -> 1405 (defined_rule_count 1456 -> 1408), both number blessed lists emptied. PARSE-NEUTRAL: SV cert-coverage witness count byte-identical 726 (only UNKNOWN dropped 615 -> 567, the 48 removed orphans) at seeds 0/7/42; external corpus 14/14; shape-contract green; no release/schema bump (orphans never parsed -> wire-shape identical). This is honest closure-debt RETIREMENT, the literal-0 doctrine in action (the regex H.10.1 / svpp trivia / vhdl white_space dead-rule-removal precedent), never masking.

v5 (2026-06-15, GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.3, PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0082): the SV cert-coverage UNKNOWN->0 drive removed the two ENGINE-SHADOWED-DEAD B4 lexical rules white_space (/[ \t\r\n]+/) and comment_only_source_region at source. Both were REACHABLE (white_space via trivia; comment_only_source_region via a source_text_item branch) but could never match their own bytes on any input because the generated layout skipper consumes whitespace AND comments as leading trivia before any non-empty-matchable regex / source_text_item branch is tried (probe-confirmed parsed=true/witnessed=false; a comment-only file parses to an empty source_text and no comment_only_source_region node has ever appeared in any AST) -- the vhdl H.11.4-UNPARK white_space literal-0 precedent. Their dead references (the trivia whitespace arm + the comment_only_source_region source_text_item branch, whose @priority list shrank [24,16,16,12,10,8,6,4] -> [24,16,16,12,10,8,4]) were removed with them. Re-baselined: min_total_rules 1405 -> 1403 (defined_rule_count 1408 -> 1406), min_reachable_rules 1406 -> 1404 (reachable_rules 1409 -> 1407), max_unreachable_branches 11 -> 2 (removing comment_only_source_region's quantifier/alternation sub-branch accounting; max_unreachable_rules stays 1 = module_path_conditional_expression). PARSE-NEUTRAL: SV cert-coverage witness count byte-identical 1170 (only UNKNOWN dropped 123 -> 121, exactly the 2 removed rules, no collateral) at seed 0, spf=0 seeds 0/7/42; external corpus 14/14; shape-contract green; no release/schema bump (the rules never parsed -> wire-shape identical). Honest closure-debt RETIREMENT, the literal-0 doctrine, never masking.

v6 (2026-06-17, GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.6.1, PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0111): the SV cert-coverage UNKNOWN->0 drive RETIRED the LAST blessed unreachable budget case, so the linter's headline 'no unreachable rules' is now LITERALLY true for systemverilog (unreachable_rules=0). module_path_conditional_expression (an LRM rule, Annex A.8.3) was stranded by an indirect LEFT-RECURSION in its producer module_path_expression: mpce's condition referenced module_path_expression, whose first branch was mpce, so the left-recursion eliminator rewrote module_path_expression into module_path_expression_lr_base/_lr_suffix and left module_path_conditional_expression as an UNREFERENCED rewritten seed (no_path). The budget-case rationalization that 'PGEN runtime RecursionGuard handles it' was DISPROVEN tools-first -- the generated parse_module_path_conditional_expression was defined-but-never-called, and the _lr_suffix reconstruction leaked raw wrapper_specs metadata into the ternary module-path AST. FIX (grammar-only, LRM A.8.3-faithful, ledger SV-0005, release 1.0.143, schema stays 4): mpce's condition is now the non-left-recursive module_path_expression_operand chain (same accepted language -- the right-associative ternary reading), so module_path_expression is natively non-left-recursive (no elimination; module_path_expression_lr_base/_lr_suffix gone), mpce is positively referenced + WITNESSED, and the wrapper_specs leak is gone. Re-baselined: max_unreachable_rules 1 -> 0 (NO rule is now intentionally kept unreachable; the blessed lrm_mutual_recursion_cases list emptied); defined_rule_count 1406 -> 1405 (the net of the LR-elimination synthetic rules no longer being created), reachable_rules now == defined_rule_count == 1405 (ALL reachable); the no-regression FLOORS min_total_rules 1403 / min_reachable_rules 1404 / max_unreachable_branches 2 are unchanged (actuals stay above them with buffer). VERIFIED: SV cert-coverage UNKNOWN 86 -> 84 (mpce + module_path_expression_lr_suffix both leave; witness 1204; total 1291 -> 1289) deterministic seeds 0/7/42 spf=0; no_path 20 -> 19 (exactly mpce; the 19 LRM-legitimate rules stay); cond.sv genuineness oracle emits a clean conditional node with 0 wrapper_specs (was 0/3); external corpus 14/14; stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate PASS; clippy source-clean. The literal-0 doctrine: a no_path budget case RETIRED by fixing the producer (never by deletion), per [[feedback_no_rule_deletion_without_lrm_proof]].
